description: Consequence from an empty propositional premise set is equivalent to tautology.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.entails_empty_iff.{u} {α : Type u} (A : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Entails ∅ A ↔ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Tautology A
